intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按“乘客未受伤 -> 雪很厚、村庄很远 -> 手提箱变小床 -> 尽量靠近孩子 -> 听到飞机、想到信号 -> 踩出 SOS -> 飞行员用无线电报信 -> 直升机救援”的故事线跟读。重点读清 were unhurt, Snow lay thick, turned a suitcase into a bed, all the clothes she could find, as near as she could, passing overhead, send a signal, stamped out, by radio, arrived on the scene 和 rescue the survivors。

sentences.text: The only passengers, a young woman and her two baby daughters, were unhurt.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：机上乘客只有一位年轻妈妈和两个女婴，她们没有受伤。读清插入语 a young woman and her two baby daughters，再落到 were unhurt。

sentences.text: Snow lay thick on the ground.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：地上积着厚厚的雪。句子很短，但 thick 是画面重点，读出厚雪带来的隔绝感。

sentences.text: When it grew dark, she turned a suitcase into a bed and put the children inside it, covering them with all the clothes she could find.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：天黑后，她把手提箱变成小床，把孩子放进去，并用所有能找到的衣服盖住。When it grew dark 后停顿，turned A into B 和 covering... 是重点。
focus_words: turned a suitcase into a bed
all the clothes she could find

sentences.text: The woman kept as near as she could to the children and even tried to get into the case herself, but it was too small.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：她尽量靠近孩子，甚至想自己也钻进箱子里，但箱子太小。as near as she could 表示尽最大努力靠近，case 指前面的 suitcase。
focus_words: kept as near as she could

sentences.text: Early next morning, she heard planes passing overhead and wondered how she could send a signal.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：第二天早晨，她听到飞机从头顶飞过，开始想怎样发送信号。Early next morning 后停顿，passing overhead 和 send a signal 是本课桥梁。

sentences.text: She stamped out the letters 'SOS' in the snow.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：她在雪地上踩出了 SOS 三个字母。stamped out 要读出连续踩出形状，不是随便踩一下。

sentences.text: Fortunately, a pilot saw the signal and sent a message by radio to the nearest town.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：幸运的是，一位飞行员看见信号，并用无线电给最近的城镇发消息。Fortunately 读出转机，by radio 是救援链条的关键。

sentences.text: It was not long before a helicopter arrived on the scene to rescue the survivors of the plane crash.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：不久，直升机来到现场救出幸存者。It was not long before 是漂亮的时间句，arrived on the scene 和 rescue the survivors 要连起来读。
